text: Introduction: Approximately 10% of patients with psychotic disorders receive the diagnosis “ Psychotic disorder not otherwise specified” (PNOS). However, there is a lack of knowledge about the clinical presentations captured by this diagnosis in the mental health services. Therefore, we examined the symptom profiles of participants with PNOS compared to participants with bipolar disorder (BD) and schizophrenia spectrum disorder (SZ) diagnoses.
source_label: Symptom Profiles in Psychotic Disorder Not Otherwise Specified
